title: helianthemum pilosum subsp. subobtusatum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum subsp. subobtusatum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
